1: // Asteroid Dodge Game – concise implementation
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   // Resize canvas to fill its container (optional)
10:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
11:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
12: 
13:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false, ArrowUp: false };
14:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true; });
15:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false; });
16: 
17:   const ship = {
18:     x: canvas.width / 2,
19:     y: canvas.height / 2,
20:     angle: 0,
21:     vx: 0,
22:     vy: 0,
23:     radius: 10,
24:     thrust: 0.1,
25:     turnSpeed: 0.06,
26:     drag: 0.99,
27:   };
28: 
29:   const asteroids = [];
30:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
31: 
32:   let lastSpawn = 0;
33:   let score = 0;
34:   let startTime = null;
35:   let gameOver = false;
36: 
37:   function spawnAsteroid() {
38:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 20;
39:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
40:     let x, y;
41:     // Spawn just outside canvas on a random side
42:     if (side === 0) { x = -radius; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; }
43:     else if (side === 1) { x = canvas.width + radius; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; }
44:     else if (side === 2) { x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = -radius; }
45:     else { x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = canvas.height + radius; }
46:     const angle = Math.atan2(canvas.height / 2 - y, canvas.width / 2 - x);
47:     const speed = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.0;
48:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, radius });
49:   }
50: 
51:   function update(dt) {
52:     // Ship rotation
53:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= ship.turnSpeed;
54:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += ship.turnSpeed;
55:     // Thrust
56:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
57:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
58:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
59:     }
60:     // Apply drag and move
61:     ship.vx *= ship.drag;
62:     ship.vy *= ship.drag;
63:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
64:     ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
65:     // Wrap around edges
66:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += canvas.width;
67:     if (ship.x > canvas.width) ship.x -= canvas.width;
68:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += canvas.height;
69:     if (ship.y > canvas.height) ship.y -= canvas.height;
70:     // Update asteroids
71:     for (const a of asteroids) {
72:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
73:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
74:     }
75:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids
76:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
77:       const a = asteroids[i];
78:       if (a.x < -a.radius || a.x > canvas.width + a.radius || a.y < -a.radius || a.y > canvas.height + a.radius) {
79:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
80:       }
81:     }
82:     // Collision detection
83:     for (const a of asteroids) {
84:       const dx = ship.x - a.x;
85:       const dy = ship.y - a.y;
86:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
87:       if (dist < ship.radius + a.radius) {
88:         gameOver = true;
89:         break;
90:       }
91:     }
92:     // Score based on elapsed time
93:     if (!gameOver && startTime !== null) score = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
94:   }
95: 
96:   function draw() {
97:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
98:     // Ship – draw as triangle
99:     ctx.save();
100:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
101:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
102:     ctx.beginPath();
103:     ctx.moveTo(ship.radius, 0);
104:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, ship.radius / 2);
105:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, -ship.radius / 2);
106:     ctx.closePath();
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
108:     ctx.fill();
109:     ctx.restore();
110:     // Asteroids – circles
111:     ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
112:     for (const a of asteroids) {
113:       ctx.beginPath();
114:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
115:       ctx.fill();
116:     }
117:     // Score display
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
119:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
120:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 20);
121:     if (gameOver) {
122:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
123:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
124:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
125:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
126:     }
127:   }
128: 
129:   function loop(timestamp) {
130:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
131:     const dt = (timestamp - (lastTime || timestamp)) / 16; // normalize to ~60fps units
132:     lastTime = timestamp;
133:     if (!gameOver) {
134:       if (timestamp - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
135:         spawnAsteroid();
136:         lastSpawn = timestamp;
137:       }
138:       update(dt);
139:     }
140:     draw();
141:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
142:   }
143: 
144:   // Start the game
145:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
146: })();
